law: Complete-system EBPW counts EVERY byte the artifact requires to run: payload, scales, zeros, norms, embeddings, manifest, and any index a codec needs to find its own corrections. A rate quoted over one component is not the rate of the system, and the gap between the two has been large enough to invert conclusions.
why_it_is_a_law_and_not_a_preference: every clause below was earned by a measurement that was wrong first

instances.what_the_missing_bytes_were: everything that is not a linear layer -- embeddings, norms, and the non-ternary tensors the body still needs to run

instances.defect: a *.safetensors glob summed consolidated.safetensors AND its 10-shard twin, reporting 48.02B for a 24B model
instances.how_it_was_caught: an exact factor of two is a counting bug until proven otherwise
instances.verification: 585 tensors in each container, zero name overlap, identical shape and dtype multisets
instances.fix: shard preference plus an assertion, in the producer

instances.case: F8_E8M0 absent from the dtype width table
instances.defect: an unknown dtype silently defaulted to 2 bytes
instances.fix: the width table now RAISES on an unknown dtype rather than defaulting. A guess that looks like a measurement is worse than a crash.

instances.case: NX artifact vs running working set
instances.measured: 462 MiB artifact against a 2384 MB dense fp32 working set, 4.92x
instances.consequence: the 3.10x file-size win does not survive contact with execution; the running set is LARGER than the bf16 parent. File size and resident size are different numbers and must be reported separately.

instances.applied: index bytes counted at full ceil(log2(N)) = 25 bits per correction plus 16 payload, no delta coding or run-length that would need its own decoder to be honest
instances.consequence: with honest indices the class is refuted by construction; with the indices omitted it would have looked like a free 2.6% repair

instances.applied: both arms write the SAME per-group affine format, so payload, scale and zero bytes are identical by construction
instances.consequence: the comparison cannot be explained away by byte accounting at all -- which is what makes a +0.02 top-1 difference meaningful

operational_rules: count at the artifact, not at the tensor a codec happens to touch
an unknown dtype raises; it never defaults
an exact factor of two between two counts is a counting bug until proven otherwise
report file size and resident working set as separate numbers, never one as the other
any index, offset or side table a decoder needs is payload
prefer arms whose byte counts are identical BY CONSTRUCTION, so accounting cannot be the explanation
fix the producer, not the receipt -- a corrected number leaves the thing that wrote it still wrong
enforcement_in_this_campaign: gravity_lib.apply_codec returns complete accounting (payload + every scrap of metadata) rather than a payload rate; mlp_bytes in the G047 harness computes the figure once and both arms assert against it; anatomy_from_bytes raises on an unknown dtype and reports tensor bytes and on-disk bytes side by side.
